en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional. Лело is used as an address/refrain; the speakers' roles (Gjorgi, Todorka) are my reading. The last two lines are a proverb-like image, my reading: a beautiful girl has no 'family' because everyone claims her.

lines.en: Let her go, Lelo, hey, Todorka,

lines.cyr: двајца на лозје, Лело, да одиме.
lines.lat: dvajca na lozje, Lelo, da odime.
lines.en: the two of us to the vineyard, Lelo, let us go.

lines.cyr: Двајца на лозје, Лело, да одиме,
lines.lat: Dvajca na lozje, Lelo, da odime,
lines.en: The two of us to the vineyard, Lelo, let us go,
sour cherries, cherries, Lelo, let us pick.

lines.cyr: Како да ја пуштам, Ѓорги, Тодорка,
lines.lat: Kako da ja puštam, Ǵorgi, Todorka,
lines.en: How can I let her go, Gjorgi, Todorka,
are we not, woe is me, relatives.
The sea is deep, Lelo, it has no bottom,
a beautiful girl, Lelo, has no kin.
